title: Toolkit lockfile
description: Records exactly which toolkit version a repository runs, so an upgrade is a reviewable diff and 'which rules was this repository held to in March' is answerable (Goal G5).

version.description: A released version (0.8.0) when the vendored tree is that release's tag, which is the default. A git describe of the toolkit checkout (v0.8.0-5-g99d2c68) only when it was vendored unreleased on purpose, and then channel says so (TK-126).

channel.description: release: the tree is the tag named by version. unreleased: the tree is a toolkit checkout ahead of a release, vendored with --unreleased. Absent in lockfiles written before this field existed, which are read from the form of version.

commit.description: Source commit, when vendored from a checkout.

profile.description: gates: CI-runnable checks only. full: adds skills and agents.

files.description: What was vendored, so drift in the vendored copy is detectable.
